f3_program: collection("cynthia.harvested_potatoes", "potato", "cynthia", source("Cynthia harvested 67 potatoes from her garden"))

fraction_of("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.used_for_french_fries.count", "cynthia.harvested_potatoes.remaining.count", 1, 2, source("made french fries with one half"))
fraction_of("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.used_for_potato_chips.count", "cynthia.harvested_potatoes.remaining.count", 1, 2, source("potato chips with the other half"))
